findings.rule: every move says what, how, why
findings.problem: "Collect the terms" jumps from 2x + 2 − 3 + y and x + 2 − 2y + 4 straight to the powers 2x + y − 1 and x − 2y + 6, so a weaker student may not see where the −1 and the +6 come from.
findings.fix: As the voice collects, light the number terms on lines 7 and 8 (the 2 and −3, then the 2 and +4) and say "two minus three is negative one" and "two plus four is six".

findings.problem: On the later beats (27–31) the "💡 Why?" chip sits over the top line of the board, covering part of "y = 10 − 2x" and the Step 5 heading as they scroll past.
findings.fix: Keep the chip clear of the maths: pad the board's top-right corner, or shrink or fade the chip once the board starts scrolling.
